draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.97, the 146th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 22nd of 35 at WR. He lasted until pick 187, well after his grade rank (146th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (10th percentile), three-cone (18th percentile). College production: 46 receiving yards in 2020, 35th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.
